title: Board directions (triodian.bd.directions.v1)
description: The board's directions BD1 to BD7, as the chair recorded them in AI Board Direction (connected mode). AI Risk Appetite reads them over its service binding or as a file, shows the relevant one on each decision, and holds back a ceiling above a direction (check K11). Written by board-direction lib/core/directions.js directionsFrom() and served at GET /api/board-directions; read by risk_appetite public/shared/directions.js directionsError(). Built from the version kept when the chair recorded the directions, never from the engagement while it is being edited.

format.description: Format and version of this file

recordedOn.description: When the chair recorded the directions

status.description: recorded by the chair, or confirmed by the board's resolution

beingRevised.description: True while positions have changed since the directions were recorded

note.description: What the file is, in plain words

directions.description: The seven directions. Each names the AI Risk Appetite decisions (d1 to d8) it is read on.

BD1.description: Posture by area, and the board's AI governance goals

name.description: Area name; AI Risk Appetite matches it to its functions by name

posture.description: Posture S1 to S4, or null if not set

maxTier.description: Highest authority tier the posture accepts

goals.description: AI governance goals: id, goal, owner, measure

BD2.description: Red lines: lines (id, use, scope, appliesTo)

BD3.description: Reserved decisions: events (id, event, timing, by) and reservedFrom, the lowest tier the board reserves before a use starts

BD4.description: Confidential information: markings (class:kind to P, C or N) and conditions

BD5.description: Harm not tolerated: harms (id, harmTo, notTolerated, threshold)

BD6.description: Reporting expected: measures (id, measure, limit, owner) and events (id, event, to, within)

readOn.description: The AI Risk Appetite decisions the direction is read on

list.description: A list of short records; every field is text

direction.description: A direction: its name, the decisions it is read on, and its content

events.description: BD3 reserved decisions, or BD6 events reported to the board

reservedFrom.description: BD3: lowest authority tier the board reserves to itself before a use starts

markings.description: BD4: information class by tool kind; P permitted, C with conditions, N not permitted

measures.description: BD6 measures reported to the board

owners.description: BD7 who is accountable for what
